wiki.title: Charniele Herring
wiki.extract: Charniele LeRhonda Herring ( shar-NEL HERR-ing; born September 25, 1969) is an American politician. She has served in the Virginia House of Delegates since 2009, representing the 4th district, made up of portions of the city of Alexandria and Fairfax County, near Washington, D.C. She is the current majority leader of the Virginia House of Delegates.
